name: AiChart EA Bridge API

auth.note: Generate the token from AiChart → الإعدادات → الربط والتكامل → MetaTrader. Shown once.

flags.reconnect: optional — server requests EA bridge re-sync
flags.resync_candles: optional — force candle push on next heartbeat

notes: v2 EA polls GET /api/ea/commands for trade commands; heartbeat carries state + flags.
Server reconciles positions[] into aichartTrades on each heartbeat.
Offline threshold: 3 consecutive missed heartbeat intervals (~90s at 30s interval).
v4: flags.reconnect / flags.resync_candles — set via POST /api/agent/ea/reconnect; cleared after one heartbeat.

commands.note: Primary command delivery for EA v2. Marks commands as sent.

request.capture_key: string (optional, for ad-hoc snapshots e.g. snap_1717000000)

quotes.note: EA v4.01: batch FlushLiveQuotes every QuoteFlushSeconds (1s) when ProcessBridgeTick runs; OnTimer(1s) ensures flush during quiet chart ticks; FlushChartSymbolQuote on every chart OnTick (throttled). Heartbeat bid/ask is NOT this stream.

command_types.open_market: Open a market order (side=buy|sell, lots, stop_loss required unless EA AllowNoSL).
command_types.close_position: Close an open position by ticket.
command_types.modify_sl_tp: Modify stop loss / take profit: { ticket, stop_loss, take_profit? }.
command_types.draw_and_capture: Clear prior AICHART_* objects, draw chart_drawings on MT5 chart, ChartScreenShot, upload PNG.
command_types.clear_chart: Delete all chart objects with prefix AICHART_{recommendation_id}_ (or all AICHART_* if no id).
command_types.open_pending: Pending order: { symbol, side, order_type: limit|stop|stop_limit, lots, price, stop_loss?, take_profit? }.
command_types.query_terminal: Snapshot margin/equity/pending orders + reference_symbol trade_execution/filling_mode (v3.01+, result in ack).
command_types.get_ohlc: On-demand candles: { symbol, timeframe, count? } → CopyRates → ack { symbol, timeframe, count, candles[] } (v4+).

reconnect.note: Sets reconnect flag; EA receives flags.reconnect on next heartbeat (~30s).

draw_and_capture_payload.symbol: MT5 symbol — broker-exact case (EURUSDm); resolved via ResolveBrokerSymbol
draw_and_capture_payload.interval: 1m|5m|15m|30m|1h|4h|1d|1w or M1|H1|… — empty or chart = Period(); used for iTime() coords only (EA does NOT change chart symbol/period)

drawings.label: optional
drawings.time_offset: optional bar index from current (alias barsAhead)

draw_and_capture_payload.poll_chart: GET /api/agent/chart/{recommendation_id}/mt5 — 202 pending until PNG ready, then 200 image/png

clear_chart_payload.interval: optional — unused for clear; objects deleted by recommendation_id prefix

idempotency: The EA remembers recent acked command ids and never executes the same command id twice.
